video:video.video:title: A.P.C. Petit New Standard Jeans | faded vintage black
video:video.video:description:
An indispensable element of any modern wardrobe, A.P.C.'s Petit Standard jeans are exceptionally crafted from Italian denim. A.P.C hand picks the best denim for its jeans, and this pair is designed to be worn in - we'd suggest not washing them for a while so they break in nicely.

 

Details:

  • 100% organic cotton faded black Italian denim
  • Caramel topstitching
  • Slim leg.
  • Straight mid-rise.
  • Five pockets
  • Button fly.
  • The first button is engraved "A.P.C. rue Madame près du Luxembourg". 
  • 12.75 oz.
  • Made in Portugal

video:video.video:title: A.P.C. Christian crewneck Sweater | beige
video:video.video:description:
A.P.C. SS23 collection

 

A.P.C.'s simplified classics have earned the brand a cult-like following since its founding in 1987. Knitted with touches of linen, this 'Christian' sweater is endlessly versatile. Wear it on warm evenings when you need an extra layer.

 

Details:

  • Straight cut.
  • Crew neck.
  • Lightweight and summery.
  •  69% viscose. 27% linen. 4% polyamide.
  • Italian material.
  • Made in Romania.
  • Hand wash or delicate cycle.

video:video.video:title: Dr Martens 1461 Shoe | black smooth leather
video:video.video:description:
Timeless since 1961. The 1461 shoe marched off the production line a year after our Original 1460 boot — and it’s never missed a beat. Classic and versatile, the shoe is built from smooth leather, which looks polished to a shine or is scuffed and well-worn. DM's bouncing sole is secured with distinctive yellow welt stitching, and the wide, rounded toe ensures all-day comfort — whatever you’re up to.

 

Details:

  • Smooth Oxford Leather

  • Whole sizes only; for 1/2 sizes, order the next size up.

  • Made with classic Docs DNA, including grooved edges, yellow stitching, and Smooth, Dm's original durable leather
  • Durable and famously stiff to start
  • 3-eye unisex style
  • Lace-up closure
  • Round toe
  • Leather & textile lining
  • Built to last with a durable Goodyear welt
  • Padded footbed
  • Dr. Marten's Air Cushioned rubber sole
  • Imported

video:video.video:title: Karhu Sneakers Fusion XC | aloe wash
video:video.video:description:
The Karhu Fusion XC Aloe Wash sneakers feature an air cushioned membrane to keep feet cool and dry, and the upper is made with mesh and suede overlays. The Fusion XC also has a plush Air Cushion midsole, a Karhu innovation from the 1970s. The outsole uses an updated version of the T-profile lug pattern used on many Karhu shoes from the previous century. 

 

Details:

  • Unisex sizing
  • Plush Air Cushion midsole
  • Inspired by several shoes from Karhu's history
  • Suede overlays
  • Sturdy mesh tongue and underlays
  • Fulcrum Technology for balanced cushioning and increased support
  • Fully gusseted tongue to keep out dirt
  • Rope laces
  • Reflective details
  • Pull tab
  • XC logo debossed heel print
  • Rubber toe Bumper for protection
  • T-profile outsole for extra grip
  • Air Cushion

  • Classic-cut T-shirt.
  • Size up for a slightly looser fit
  • Small printed 'A.P.C. ITEM 0001' logo.
  • Soft cotton.
  • Made in Turkey

video:video.video:title: A.P.C. VPC T-Shirt | heather ecru/orange
video:video.video:description:
A.P.C. knows the small details make all the difference. Styled with the label’s iconic flipped minimal logo, this VPC T-shirt reveals that it's flocked for texture, and the 'A' is flipped upside down., it’s crafted from soft pure cotton and offers a comfy, regular fit.  It's cut from cotton jersey in a comfortable fit that's ideal for layering beneath denim jackets, overshirts, and knitwear.

 

Details:

  • 100% Organic cotton.
  • Soft, comfortable material.
  • Regular fit (we recommend sizing up for a looser fit)
  • Straight cut.
  • Crew neckline.
  • Large flocked velvet V.P.C. logo. 
  • Straight hem.
  • Topstitched hem.
  • Imported

video:video.video:title: New Balance 990 Sneakers | navy
video:video.video:description:
New Balance M990 Sneakers Made in the USA in navy

With a legacy that spans over three decades, this timeless go-to sets the industry standard. Designed without compromise, the NV5 blends the perfect combination of cushioning and stability. The result: a shoe that looks – and feels – as good on your morning run as it does on the runway. The Made in the USA 990

manufactured in the US for over 75 years and representing a limited portion of US sales. New Balance Made is a premium collection that contains a domestic value of 70% or greater.

 

Details:

  • M990NV5
  • Navy
  • Made in the USA
  • Pigskin suede upper
  • Mesh underlays
  • ENCAP tooling
  • Rubber outsole

video:video.video:title: A.P.C. New Standard Jeans | stonewash indigo
video:video.video:description:
APC New Standard jeans in Stonewash Indigo are a popular choice among denim enthusiasts for their quality and timeless style.

 

  • APC's New Standard Jeans feature a straight cut. It's designed to be more fitted than the classic straight leg but not as tight as slim-fit jeans. This makes them versatile for various body types and styling options.
  • APC's New Standard jeans are made from high-quality 100% cotton denim. APC is known for its raw denim, which often means the fabric is unwashed and unprocessed when you first get them, but the Stonewash Indigo variant has been pre-washed for a softer feel and a more broken-in look right from the start.
  • The Stonewash Indigo color is a medium blue with a slightly faded effect, giving it a vintage vibe while maintaining a modern appeal.

 

Details:

  • Egyptian cotton denim.
  • Straight cut.
  • Mid-rise.
  • Five pockets.
  • Button fly.
  • Button engraved 'A.P.C. rue Madame près du Luxembourg'.
  • Caramel topstitching.
  • 100% Cotton
  • style code: COHAD-M09001

video:video.video:title: Adidas Samba OG Women's Sneakers ID0478 | cream white/black/sand strata
video:video.video:description:
For those who set trends rather than follow them, the Adidas Samba OG shoes are a must-have. Originally made for indoor football, these kicks have long transcended their sporty beginnings. A premium leather upper and nubuck overlays come together to form an iconic silhouette that's perfect for stepping out in style. Gold accents and signature 3-stripes down the side subtly nod to Adidas heritage. A true classic redefined for today's tastemaker.

 

Details:

  • Regular fit
  • Lace closure
  • Full grain leather upper 
  • Gold foil details
  • Gum rubber midsole
  • Imported
  • Cream White / Core Black / Sand Strata
  • Product code: ID0478

video:video.video:description:
Rains Gym Bag is thoughtfully created with sporting demands in mind, Rains Gym Bag is a design that is perfect for weekend breaks as well. The boxy, paired-down silhouette features a front zip pocket and a large main compartment. This waterproof bag can be carried over the shoulder or across the body with its adjustable webbing shoulder strap or by hand using its durable handles finished with a handle wrap for extra comfort.

Gym Bag is cut in Rains’ signature waterproof PU fabric, engineered for carrying strength, durability, and a smooth feel.

  • Single main compartment
  • Front zip pocket

This classic denim piece is a must-have for any wardrobe.

video:video.video:title: Adidas Mexico 26 Home Soccer Jersey JL8537 | bold green
video:video.video:description:
Mexico soccer jersey in home colors, featuring Climacool for cool, dry comfort.

Honoring the artistry and spirit of pre-Hispanic design, the subtle graphic on this Mexico 26 Away Jersey draws inspiration from the intricacy of ancient symbols unearthed across the country.

 

Cool. Dry. Ready. Climacool wicks and disperses sweat for cool, dry performances with minimal distractions. Combined with this jersey's soft doubleknit fabric and slim, streamlined fit, this helps produce a comfortable feel off the field and confident play on it. Sitting below a classic V-neck collar, the iconic adidas Trefoil and that all-important federation badge are testament to your sporty style and passion for first-class soccer.

video:video.video:title: Adidas Samba JP Sneakers JQ9055 | cloud white/black/gum
video:video.video:description:
Explore the timeless appeal of the Adidas Samba JP Sneakers JQ9055 in core white/black/Gum sole. A high-quality leather and suede construction takes over the top-half, which looks to archival design elements to breathe new life into the decades-old sneaker. The quilted toe cap falls in line with football boots like the Copa Mundial, injecting an overt touch of heritage into the offering. Profile 3-Stripes take on a smooth finish, adding a modern twist to the classic silhouette. This pair stays true to the original with a leather upper and serrated 3-Stripes, but gets an update with a suede heel cap and rubber outsole. Blending pitch-inspired details with street-ready appeal, these sneakers are ready to make an impact wherever you take them. They come with a second pair of laces in tonal colors.

 

Details:

  • Regular fit
  • Lace closure
  • Gum sole
  • Leather and synthetic upper
  • Synthetic lining
  • Rubber outsole
  • Imported
  • Product color: Cloud White / Black / Gum
  • Product code: JQ9055

video:video.video:title: Adidas Climacool Laced Shoes KJ8968 | off-white/black
video:video.video:description:
The Climacool Laced Shoes are where innovation meets style. Crafted for those who appreciate an elegant, street-style design that doesn't compromise on performance. Cool. Dry. Ready. Breathable materials and open constructions keep your feet dry and comfortable. The synthetic upper and lining add to the comfort, while the subtle adidas branding provide a classic appeal. These shoes, with their airflow movement pattern and foot-hugging sensation, offer a feeling of a slide. With a regular fit and lace closure, these shoes are a versatile choice for everyday wear. From attending a casual meet-up to exploring the city, redefine your fashion sense with these adidas shoes.

 

Adidas' Climacool, as a 3D-printed proposition, remains the German giant’s strongest devotee of that on-demand, buzzy technology, now splayed over a one-piece moc and the Laced style at hand. Though the monochrome pairs that first served the silhouette to the masses are in the rearview, still tonal, earthy choices are front of mind for adi. True to that, the Climacool Laced takes on an “Off-White” foundation before acquiring silver shading on the Three Stripes, closing out with purer white on the tongue and laces.

video:video.video:title: Adidas Samba JP Sneakers JQ7824 | off white /magic beige /core black
video:video.video:description:
Explore the timeless appeal of the Adidas Samba JP Sneakers. A high-quality leather and suede construction takes over the top-half, which looks to archival design elements to breathe new life into the decades-old sneaker. The quilted toe cap falls in line with football boots like the Copa Mundial, injecting an overt touch of heritage into the offering. Profile 3-Stripes take on a smooth finish, adding a modern twist to the classic silhouette.

This pair stays true to the original with a leather upper and serrated 3-Stripes, but gets an update with a suede heel cap and rubber outsole. Blending pitch-inspired details with street-ready appeal, these sneakers are ready to make an impact wherever you take them. They come with a second pair of laces in tonal colors.

video:video.video:title: Adidas BW Army Sneakers | core black/gum sole
video:video.video:description:
Most people meet this shoe under a name that costs four figures. Maison Margiela's Replica made the silhouette famous, but it didn't make it first. The German Army Trainer began as the BW-Sport, adidas' indoor trainer for the Bundeswehr in the 1970s: plain, unbranded, built for soldiers and nothing more. When Margiela walked it down the runway in 1998, it was surplus pairs of this shoe on their feet, years before the house made its own.

 

The adidas BW Army is that original, drawn back out of the archive. A premium leather base with real depth, suede overlays worn soft at the edges, a leather lining that gives a little more with every wear. No three stripes, because a shoe built for the army had nothing to sell. It reads as easily under a suit as with everything else you own, the kind you reach for without thinking and never quite retire.

 

They're a celebration of timeless design, made for those who appreciate quality and effortless versatility.

video:video.video:description:
The Italy 26 Home Jersey is a tribute to the heart and soul of Italian soccer. Crafted with passion and precision, this jersey embodies the celebration and significance of the FIGC's storied history. It captures the essence of Italy's soccer legacy.

 

Designed for those who live and breathe the game, this jersey offers a slim fit that complements your athletic silhouette. The interlock construction provides durability and comfort, making it a smart choice for on-field game usage.

This jersey features the Climacool technology. Cool. Dry. Ready. Climacool wicks and disperses sweat for a cool, dry, and distraction-free performance. Whether you're playing in a high-stakes game or cheering from the stands, this jersey is your gateway to the world of Italian soccer. Go ahead and make this adidas piece your own.

video:video.video:description: Adizero EVO SL WOVEN Shoes are here to redefine your run. Inspired by the record-breaking EVO 1, they deliver the versatility and performance serious runners demand. Powered by adidas LightstrikePro technology, this super-light midsole is redefining the next generation of speed with cushioning built for dynamic, lightweight movement and optimal responsiveness. The regular fit keeps things easy, adjustable lacing locks you in, and the textile upper and lining provide breathability and durability. Underfoot, the rubber outsole offers steady traction on road surfaces. Whether you're training for a marathon or chasing a new personal best, these trainers deliver a balance of performance and speed-driven design, so you can focus on your run.

The classic Samba Shoes, reimagined as Mary Janes.

video:video.video:title: New Balance 950 Sneakers U950384 | tonal cream/grey/white
video:video.video:description:
A new chapter in New Balance's court lineage. The 950 is a fresh inline silhouette, not a reissue, drawing on the brand's retro basketball heritage while sitting in the same lane as the beloved 550, only cleaner and more refined. It first surfaced on the feet of Cooper Flagg, New Balance's young basketball cornerstone, who debuted the shoe in the tunnel during his standout rookie season, a quiet signal of where the brand's court direction is headed.

 

This colorway leans fully tonal. Smooth cream leather forms the body, with brushed oatmeal suede on the toe and heel and a suede N logo framed by a slightly warmer panel. Soft grey outlines trace the paneling, and a pre-yellowed vintage-cream midsole grounds it with a broken-in feel from day one.

video:video.video:description:
Discover a fresh take on Y2K style with the New Balance 204L. This low-profile sneaker offers an unexpected interpretation of 2000s running shoe culture, blending heritage design with modern streetwear appeal.

Built for those who appreciate archival style, the 204L marries the slim, lightweight structure of '70s track shoes with the rich, tech-inspired texture of premium suede. By pulling standout design elements from past and present New Balance classics, this shoe creates an aesthetic that is both nostalgic and contemporary. Highlighted by its sleek proportions and dynamic arced overlay lines, the 204L is a uniquely stylish, easy-to-wear staple for any sneaker collection.

video:video.video:title: Adidas Climacool Laced Shoes KJ8969 | off-white/silver
video:video.video:description:
The Climacool Laced Shoes are where innovation meets style. Crafted for those who appreciate an elegant, street-style design that doesn't compromise on performance. Cool. Dry. Ready. Breathable materials and open constructions keep your feet dry and comfortable. The synthetic upper and lining add to the comfort, while the subtle adidas branding provide a classic appeal. These shoes, with their airflow movement pattern and foot-hugging sensation, offer a feeling of a slide. With a regular fit and lace closure, these shoes are a versatile choice for everyday wear. From attending a casual meet-up to exploring the city, redefine your fashion sense with these adidas shoes.

 

Adidas' Climacool, as a 3D-printed proposition, remains the German giant’s strongest devotee of that on-demand, buzzy technology, now splayed over a one-piece moc and the Laced style at hand. Though the monochrome pairs that first served the silhouette to the masses are in the rearview, still tonal, earthy choices are front of mind for adi. True to that, the Climacool Laced takes on an “Off-White” foundation before acquiring silver shading on the Three Stripes, closing out with purer white on the tongue and laces.

video:video.video:title: Adidas BW Army Sneakers KK2801 | chalk white/clear granite/gum sole
video:video.video:description:
Most people meet this shoe under a name that costs four figures. Maison Margiela's Replica made the silhouette famous, but it didn't make it first. The German Army Trainer began as the BW-Sport, adidas' indoor trainer for the Bundeswehr in the 1970s: plain, unbranded, built for soldiers and nothing more. When Margiela walked it down the runway in 1998, it was surplus pairs of this shoe on their feet, years before the house made its own.

 

The adidas BW Army is that original, drawn back out of the archive. A premium leather base with real depth, suede overlays worn soft at the edges, a leather lining that gives a little more with every wear. No three stripes, because a shoe built for the army had nothing to sell. It reads as easily under a suit as with everything else you own, the kind you reach for without thinking and never quite retire.

 

They're a celebration of timeless design, made for those who appreciate quality and effortless versatility.

video:video.video:description:
The Argentina 26 Home Jersey is more than just a jersey; it's a celebration of Argentina's soccer legacy. This kit is inspired by the jerseys worn during Argentina's three World Cup victories in '78, '86, and '22, and complemented by the federation's year of foundation as a proud sign-off.

 

Cool. Dry. Ready. Climacool wicks and disperses sweat for a cool, dry, and distraction-free performance. The jersey's doubleknit construction offers durability and comfort, while its slim fit hugs the body, allowing for unrestricted movement on the field. Celebrate the spirit of the World Champions with this jersey.

video:video.video:description:
A style embraced by football fans and fashionistas, the Adidas Handball Spezial Sneakers  in maroon/black are done in premium nubuck suede. First introduced in 1979 for elite handball players, these shoes have transcended the sport to become a beloved classic. This version boasts a cow suede upper, offering a supple feel that exemplifies quality and taste. The soft gum rubber outsole ensures they stay true to their vintage roots, making them a perfect fit for the curated collection at Evolve Clothing Gallery. Discover the blend of style and substance that has made these sneakers a timeless favorite.

 

Details:

  • Regular fit
  • Lace closure
  • Cow suede upper with synthetic details
  • Gum rubber outsole
  • Enjoy the comfort and performance of OrthoLite® sockliner
  • Soft feel
  • Imported
  • Product color: Dark Brown/Alumina/Wonder Mauve
  • Product code: JR0852

video:video.video:title: Adidas Samba OG Sneakers IG1024 | core white/green
video:video.video:description:
Born on the pitch, the Samba is a timeless icon of street style. This silhouette stays true to its legacy with a tasteful, low-profile, soft mesh upper, suede overlays, and gum sole, making it a staple in everyone's closet, on and off the pitch.

At ECG, we believe in curating pieces that epitomize quality and taste, and these black mesh knit sneakers are no exception. Step into a world where style meets substance with the Adidas Samba OG Men's Sneakers, exclusively selected for the discerning sneaker enthusiast.

 

Details:

  • Regular fit
  • Lace closure
  • Knit mesh  upper with suede overlays
  • Synthetic leather lining; Gum rubber cupsole
  • Gum rubber midsole
  • Imported
  • Product color: Core White / Green 
  • Product code: IG1024

video:video.video:title: Malin+Goetz Cannabis Candle | 9oz
video:video.video:description:
M+G's cannabis scent is a daily supplement to city living. known to calm + ground, the four-dimensional scent for the mind and body transcends spaces and experiences. we can close our eyes wherever we are and disappear into a lazy afternoon spent dwelling on a favorite record with a lingering smokiness that can permeate any room.

cannabis has always been used in secret to soothe + enlighten. now, we’ve unearthed the apothecary staple’s ability to nourish with herbaceous and verdant aromas that simultaneously ground us in awareness while allowing us to escape. cannabis balances wild notes of bergamot, black pepper and cedarwood with soft, floral notes of muguet and magnolia.

Their candles are made with high-quality perfume oils and a vegetable wax blend with a clean, slow burn that lasts 60 hours. suitable for burning alone or in unexpected pairings for a unique experience. after the wax has burned through, our glass vessels can even be cleaned and upcycled as beautiful drinking glasses or decorative containers.

video:video.video:title: Adidas Samba JP Sneakers JQ9056 | black/white/gum
video:video.video:description:
Explore the timeless appeal of the Adidas Samba JP Sneakers. A high-quality leather and suede construction takes over the top-half, which looks to archival design elements to breathe new life into the decades-old sneaker. The quilted toe cap falls in line with football boots like the Copa Mundial, injecting an overt touch of heritage into the offering. Profile 3-Stripes take on a smooth finish, adding a modern twist to the classic silhouette. This pair stays true to the original with a leather upper and serrated 3-Stripes, but gets an update with a suede heel cap and rubber outsole. Blending pitch-inspired details with street-ready appeal, these sneakers are ready to make an impact wherever you take them. They come with a second pair of laces in tonal colors.

 

Details:

  • Regular fit
  • Gum Sole
  • Lace closure
  • Leather and synthetic upper
  • Synthetic lining
  • Rubber outsole
  • Imported
  • Product color: Black/White/ Gum
  • Product code: JQ9056

Discover the blend of style and substance that has made these sneakers a timeless favorite.

At ECG, we believe in curating pieces that epitomize quality and taste, and these black mesh knit sneakers are no exception. Step into a world where style meets substance with the Adidas Samba OG Men's Sneakers, exclusively selected for the discerning sneaker enthusiast.

  • Lace closure
  • Knit mesh  upper with suede overlays
  • Synthetic leather lining; Gum rubber cupsole
  • Gum rubber midsole
  • Imported
  • Product color: Core Black / Cream White

video:video.video:title: Adidas Argentina 26 Away Soccer Jersey JM8395 | black/lucid blue/blue burst
video:video.video:description:
An Argentina away kit jersey with Climacool for cool, dry match day comfort.

 

Inspired by the vibrant spirit and creative passion that defines Argentine culture, this adidas Argentina 26 Away Jersey catches the eye with swirling lines and bold hues. Crafted for comfort on and off the field, it features a slim cut for a streamlined feel and a high crewneck for a modern fit.

 

Cool. Dry. Ready. Climacool wicks and disperses sweat for cool, dry performances with minimal distractions, even when the game goes into overdrive. Designed to be worn by loyal fans, this soccer jersey has an embroidered federation crest sewn onto its chest. In combination with its disruptive design, it will let you show your support with a look that’s as dynamic as the team itself.

video:video.video:title: Jason Markk Repel Shoe Protector Spray | 5.4fl oz
video:video.video:description:
Our water-based Repel formula is VOC-free and does not contain PFAS, PFOA or PFCs (forever chemicals). It safely creates a durable, breathable barrier that dries clear and effectively protects against liquid and dirt. Repel is safe to use on most absorbent materials including leather, suede, nubuck, canvas, cotton, nylon, knit, woven, mesh and more (Not recommended for unsealed leather or vegetable tanned leather). The non-aerosol delivery system outputs a continuous fine mist covering large areas quickly and evenly in all directions.

This product’s efficacy has proudly achieved a score of 100 (ISO 5) using the AATCC Test Method 22-2005. You can learn more about the AATCC Test Method here.

The bottle is fully recyclable. We encourage you to save the spray applicator and purchase the available Repel Refill when it comes time to re-up. Additionally, we proudly use Avery Dennison CleanFlake™ technology which ensures that labels and adhesive separate from PET every time, increasing the yields of pure PET flakes.

video:video.video:description:
Malin+Goetz's best-selling moisturizer keeps your skin balanced + hydrated all day. lightweight formula is quick to absorb + is intensely nourishing, delivering just the right amount of moisture without feeling greasy or sticky. pairs perfectly with their best-selling grapefruit face cleanser as part of an uncomplicated regimen.+ 100% agree overall feeling of skin improved.+ 100% agree skin felt hydrated all day.+ 100% agree skin feels softer.+ 96% agree overall appearance of skin improved.* *

 

*Based on an independent 3rd party clinical research study on 32 subjects with normal, oily, and dry skin. used daily for two weeks.

 

How it works.
Vitamin E is a stable antioxidant that strengthens + defends the skin against environmental aggressors.

Fatty acids + soothing chamomile oil trap hydration in the skin + slow down the evaporation of water throughout the day.

Sodium hyaluronate + vitamin B5 bind water to the skin, enhancing water retention + skin moisture.

 

INGREDIENTS.

+ chamomile fatty acids nourish + soothe.
+ sodium hyaluronate + panthenol hydrate + nourish.
+ Vitamin E provides antioxidant protection.

vegan. cruelty-free.
